title: Requiem & Decryption
subtitle: Clues, card order and Lich hunts

entries.title: How a Hunt Works
entries.summary: One full round, from clues to rewards

blocks.text: This chapter teaches you to defeat this mod's boss, the {lang:entity.kuvalich.kuva_master}. Just killing it is not a win: first you work out an <hl>answer</hl> that belongs only to you, then kill it with that answer in place.

items: Gather clues: personally kill Kuva enemies such as the {lang:entity.kuvalich.kuva_slave} to build decryption progress. Each time a stage fills, one card of the answer is revealed. [[requiem/decryption|More]]

Get the cards: Requiem Cards are 8 kinds of card items, and the answer is 3 of them, so you need those actual three. Mining {item:kuvalich:requiem_ore} drops them, and 3 cards you do not need can be traded for 1 random new one. [[requiem/requiem_cards|More]]
Set the cards: place the three cards in the {item:kuvalich:requiem_gate} in the order you think is right. [[requiem/requiem_gate|More]]
Hunt: personally kill a {lang:entity.kuvalich.kuva_master}. The answer is checked the moment it dies.
Result: a right guess is a decryption success; collect your rewards and a new round begins. A wrong guess means Lich level +1; adjust your cards and try again. [[requiem/decrypt_failure|More]]

blocks.text: Unfamiliar terms can be looked up in [[start/glossary]].
In Warframe, a Kuva Lich takes over planets on the Star Chart: run missions in its territory and it skims a share of your rewards, which you only get back by defeating it.

entries.title: Decryption Progress
entries.summary: Kill Kuva enemies to reveal three clues

blocks.text: Every player has an <hl>answer</hl> of their own: 3 [[requiem/requiem_cards|Requiem Cards]] in a fixed order. It starts out hidden, and you dig it out one card at a time by killing Kuva enemies to build <t>decryption progress</t>.
The {lang:entity.kuvalich.kuva_slave} never appears in the wild, so you build progress by killing the {lang:entity.kuvalich.kuva_master} instead.

blocks.title: You must land the killing blow
blocks.text: Progress goes only to the player who personally lands the killing blow; in a group, only the finisher gets it. Kills by pets, lava, or bonus element damage such as burning or electricity do not count. Finish enemies off yourself; melee or arrows both work.
Three stages

items: Each full stage reveals one answer card and the bar starts over; <g>leftover points carry into the next stage</g>.
<hl>The moment Clue 1 appears, the whole answer is locked in</hl>: which 3 cards and in what order never change after that. From then on you can challenge at any time.
Revealed cards show up in the clue slots on the bottom row of the [[requiem/requiem_gate]] screen. <w>Clue slot positions are random and do not show the order.</w>
After all three clues are revealed, kills stop adding progress and the action bar reminds you to set your cards.

blocks.text: In Warframe this progress is called Murmurs: each full stage reveals one Requiem mod, and once all three stages are full you know the whole answer.

Whenever you gain progress, a bar pops up at the top of the screen with <t>Clue N/3</t> and your current points, then fades after about <t>4</t> seconds. The action bar also reports how many points you just gained.

blocks.title: Progress stays with you
blocks.text: Progress, clues and the answer are stored on you: dying, logging out or changing dimensions loses nothing, and every player has their own. Only a <g>successful decryption</g> clears them, and the next round rolls a new answer.
From Clue 1 onward, anything you pick up may be confiscated by the Lich, see [[requiem/confiscation]].
Advanced details

items: Progress from a Lich: both ends of the Thrall range are multiplied and rounded down, then a random value is picked between them.
The kill that completes a successful decryption adds no progress; the round simply resets.
One kill reveals at most one card, even if the points would cover two stages.

A killing blow from bonus [[combat/elements|element]] damage, such as burning or gas damage-over-time or the extra hit from electricity or blast, does not count at all: no progress and none of this mod's drops. The same goes for kills by pets or lava.

entries.title: Requiem Cards
entries.summary: 8 cards, 3 uses, spent only on success

blocks.text: Requiem Cards are the keys you slot into the [[requiem/requiem_gate]], and there are 8 kinds. Your answer is <t>3 different cards</t> from them, in a fixed order.

items: kuvalich:khra
kuvalich:jahu
kuvalich:fass
kuvalich:lohk
kuvalich:netra
kuvalich:vome
kuvalich:xata
kuvalich:ris
blocks.caption: All 8 Requiem Cards

blocks.text: The 3 cards are all different, so there are 8 × 7 × 6 = <t>336</t> possible sequences. Two copies of the same card can never be right.
Durability: only success costs a use

items: Each <g>successful decryption</g> takes 1 use from each of the three cards in the Gate. One set lasts at most <t>3</t> successes.
<g>A failed decryption costs no durability</g>. Inserting, removing or reordering cards costs nothing either, so testing orders is free.
After a success, cards with uses left go back to your inventory; if it is full, they drop where the [[enemies/kuva_master|Lich]] died.
Requiem Cards do not stack, one per slot.

blocks.text: The names of these 8 cards all come from Warframe's Requiem mods. There, too, each one has a limited number of uses and is gone once they run out.
Where to get them

rows: Each block may drop 1 random card; chances below, details in [[world/requiem_ore]]
Any 3 cards become 1 random <g>new card</g>, see [[weapons/requiem_recast]]
<t>{cfg:kuva_lich.baseCardDropChance|pctv}</t>; <w>each Fortune level lowers it by {cfg:kuva_lich.fortuneReductionPerLevel|pctv}</w>, down to <t>{cfg:kuva_lich.minCardDropChance|pctv}</t>

blocks.title: Recycle worn cards
blocks.text: Put three yellow cards with 1 use left into the {item:kuvalich:requiem_recast} to get back 1 fresh card with 3 uses. The new card is equally likely to be any of the 8 and may repeat one you put in.

entries.title: Requiem Gate
entries.summary: Setting cards, the challenge and rewards

blocks.text: The {item:kuvalich:requiem_gate} is the block where you set your answer. Put three [[requiem/requiem_cards|Requiem Cards]] in it in the order you think is right, then kill a [[enemies/kuva_master]]. The answer is checked the moment it dies.
The screen

rows: Your answer: positions 1, 2, 3 from left to right
Decryption progress for the current stage
Revealed clue cards; <w>positions are random, not the order</w>

blocks.title: Cards live on you, not in the block
blocks.text: Closing the screen saves the cards to your own data. Any Requiem Gate shows your own cards and other players see theirs; breaking the block drops no cards.
The challenge

items: Reveal at least 1 clue first, see [[requiem/decryption]]. Challenging with no clue revealed always fails.
Right-click the Requiem Gate, fill all three slots with cards and close the screen to save.

items.text: Find a {lang:entity.kuvalich.kuva_master}: they turn up in the wild, or you can summon one with a {item:kuvalich:requiem_ultimatum}. Land the killing blow yourself.
Find a {lang:entity.kuvalich.kuva_master}: they turn up in the wild. Land the killing blow yourself.
Summon a {lang:entity.kuvalich.kuva_master} with a {item:kuvalich:requiem_ultimatum} and land the killing blow yourself.

items: Check the result: a success drops rewards; a failure tells you in chat how many positions in a row you got right, counting from the first, see [[requiem/decrypt_failure]].

header: In the Gate at the kill
rows: Not a challenge: progress only, no penalty
<g>Decryption success</g>: rewards below, the round resets
Decryption failure: [[requiem/decrypt_failure|Lich level]] +1. No durability lost, and you still get progress

blocks.text: Success rewards

items: Kuva weapons are this mod's own weapons, see [[weapons/kuva_weapons]]. Their level is rolled within your weapon level range.

A new character's range is <t>{cfg:kuva_lich.baseMinimumLevel}~{cfg:kuva_lich.baseMaximumLevel}</t>, and your first success rolls a weapon level inside it. Each later success raises it until it hits its cap, see [[weapons/weapon_level]].

High-tier mod: mods are upgrade cards you fit to a weapon or to yourself. This one comes from the top two quality tiers: {cfg:kuva_lich.masterPrimeModuleChance|pctv} Prime, otherwise Riven, see [[modules/module_rarity]].
<t>{cfg:kuva_lich.moduleWeaponRatio|pctv}</t> of them are weapon mods and the rest are Warframe mods. 'Warframe' here simply means you: Warframe mods go on yourself.

blocks.title: Rewards drop where the Lich dies
blocks.text: Apart from the cards returned to your inventory, every reward <w>drops at the Lich's death spot</w>. Do not finish it near lava, the void or deep water.
Advanced details

items: Stay within <t>8</t> blocks of the Gate while its screen is open.
Once two or more clues are revealed, the bottom-row clue cards keep shuffling.
Want progress from a Lich kill without risking a failure? Take one card out of the Gate first.
If your inventory is full, unspent Requiem Cards drop at the Lich's death spot.

Weapon level range: after each success the minimum and maximum both rise by the same random amount, {cfg:kuva_lich.minimumLevelCapIncrease}~{cfg:kuva_lich.maximumLevelCapIncrease}, capped at {cfg:kuva_lich.minimumLevel} / {cfg:kuva_lich.maximumLevel}.
Both ends rise by the same amount, so the range keeps its width until one end hits its cap. This kill's weapon uses the range from before the increase.
In Creative mode, press <t>TAB</t> in the Requiem Gate to fill in the correct answer. It only works once at least 1 clue is revealed, and your old cards go back to your inventory.

entries.title: Failure & Guessing the Order
entries.summary: What a wrong guess costs, and max tries

blocks.text: If all three slots are filled but wrong, killing a [[enemies/kuva_master|Lich]] is a decryption failure. Chat gives you a hint to narrow things down; the cost is Lich level +1.
Hints on failure

rows: Positions 1 and 2 are right; only position 3 is wrong
Position 1 is wrong; nothing about the other two

blocks.text: Hints only count from the left: position 2 is checked only when position 1 is right.

blocks.title: When the first two are right
blocks.text: If your three cards are all different, 'first two right' means the third card is not in the answer at all. Swap in a different card.
When you know all three cards

items: Put the three cards in any order and kill a Lich.
Position 1 right → swap the last two; the next try wins.
No hint → move one of the other two cards into position 1 and try again.
Still no hint → position 1 is the remaining card. At most one more miss: swap the last two.

blocks.text: With this method you fail at most 3 times, and the 4th try always wins. If you have a {item:kuvalich:requiem_riddle}, just use it and never miss.
The cost of failing: Lich level
Each failure raises your Lich level by 1, and chat reports the new level. It is stored on you, survives death and logging out, and only resets on a successful decryption.
Damage Kuva enemies deal to you × (1 + Lich level × {cfg:kuva_lich.increaseDamage})
Damage you deal to Kuva enemies × (1 − Lich level × {cfg:kuva_lich.reducedDamage}), reduced by at most 99.9%

blocks.title: Only against Kuva enemies
blocks.text: Your Lich level only affects damage between you and Kuva enemies (Thralls and Liches). Falls, other mobs and other players are unaffected, so everyday exploring is as usual.
Your Lich level does not change the damage you deal or take; a wrong guess just adds 1 to the number.
In Warframe, stabbing a Lich with the wrong Requiem mods does not kill it; it ranks up and grows stronger instead.

blocks.title: Long fights get dangerous
blocks.text: Also keep in mind while hunting: once a Kuva enemy has a target, its damage grows by <t>{cfg:kuva_lich.battleBoost|pct}</t> of its base every second; without a target it drains at the same rate. If you are losing, back off first. See [[enemies/battle_boost]].

entries.title: Confiscation & Return
entries.summary: The Lich takes pickups until you win

blocks.text: From the moment you reveal Clue 1 until you win the round, whenever you pick something up, the [[enemies/kuva_master|Lich]] may confiscate the whole stack. A successful decryption gives everything back.

rows: When you touch a dropped item to pick it up
Everything at once on a successful decryption

blocks.title: It takes the whole stack
blocks.text: It takes <w>the entire stack</w> you were picking up: a dropped stack of 64 diamonds means all 64 are gone. The limit counts confiscations, one per stack, not individual items.

items: Items already in your inventory are never taken.
When something is confiscated, the Lich taunts you in chat.
Confiscated items are recorded on you; dying, logging out or changing dimensions does not lose them.
A failed decryption returns nothing and does not reset the limit; only a success counts.
Picking up your own drops after dying rolls for every stack as well.

blocks.title: Full inventory? Do not stand on drops
blocks.text: A normal pickup rolls once. But when a full inventory stops you picking an item up, it rolls 20 times a second, so the longer you stand there, the more likely you lose it.
Getting it back
When you kill the Lich with a successful decryption, every last confiscated item drops at the Lich's death spot, and chat tells you so. The round is over by then, so picking them up is safe.
They are ordinary dropped items: they despawn if left too long and burn in lava, so grab them quickly.

Four items used for decryption and hunts: a gem for crafting blocks, a riddle that shows the answer, an ultimatum that summons a [[enemies/kuva_master|Lich]], and the reliquary you only get from a successful hunt.

items: kuvalich:requiem_gem
kuvalich:requiem_riddle
kuvalich:requiem_ultimatum
kuvalich:lich_reliquary

blocks.text: {item:kuvalich:requiem_gem}

Dropped by {lang:entity.kuvalich.kuva_slave}s you kill yourself. Base chance <t>{cfg:kuva_lich.slaveRequiemGemBaseChance|pctv}</t>, plus <t>{cfg:kuva_lich.slaveRequiemGemLootingBonus|pctv}</t> per level of <t>Looting</t> on your main-hand weapon.
{item:kuvalich:requiem_riddle}
Right-click it and chat tells you this round's <hl>three cards in the correct order</hl>. Uses up 1.

items: You need at least 1 clue revealed first. Used too early, it is not consumed; it only says there is no answer yet and goes on a <t>10</t>-second cooldown.
This mod never produces it: no recipe and no drops. It is only in the Creative tab.

blocks.text: {item:kuvalich:requiem_ultimatum}

Right-click to summon a {lang:entity.kuvalich.kuva_master}. It uses up 1, except in Creative. Used on air, the Lich appears <t>3</t> blocks in front of you; used on a block, it appears on the face you clicked.
A successful decryption has a <t>{cfg:kuva_lich.requiemUltimatumDropChance|pctv}</t> chance to drop one.
This mod never produces it: no recipe and no drops. It is only in the Creative tab.
What you summon is the real boss. Set your cards and gear up first, and use it somewhere open and safe.
{item:kuvalich:lich_reliquary}
Every successful decryption drops exactly 1. The three blocks below all need one to craft, so you cannot build any of them before your first successful hunt.
With the TACZ gun mod installed, it can also permanently enhance guns in the {item:kuvalich:requiem_evolve}, see [[tacz/tacz_enhance]].
{item:kuvalich:kuva} and {item:kuvalich:riven_sliver} are the other main hunt rewards; see [[start/materials]] for their uses.
